decision_notes: States of Deliberation: primary laws, ordinances, annual budget and scrutiny of legislation, policy, services and expenditure are documented by Parliament. Guernsey is a Crown Dependency jurisdiction, not part of the United Kingdom. Alderney and Sark have separate legislatures; publication does not claim their proceedings or an ordinary UK subdivision.

The official 21 October 2026 meeting page links to morning and afternoon recordings on the States of Guernsey channel. Both decoded at 640x360 with advancing time and frames; the afternoon recording is unlisted but explicitly linked by Parliament. The index also designates BBC live coverage, which was not tested on air. A 22 October row has an obvious year typo (0026); raw labels are not reliable XMLTV dates.
